collections_offline: You’re offline. The list shows what was last loaded and updates when you’re back online.
collections_access_lost: You no longer have access to this list. Ask a workspace admin if you need it.
collections_page_mismatch: This page link no longer matches its filters.
collections_invalid_view: This view asks for something the list can’t do right now.
collections_refresh_failed: The list couldn’t be refreshed. You’re seeing what was last loaded, which may be outdated.
collections_view_archive_body: People who use this view will no longer see it among their views. Its history is kept, and records are not affected.
collections_view_make_default: Make my default for this page
collections_view_reset_done: This page is back to its default view and display settings.
collections_view_unavailable: This view isn’t available. It may have been archived or is no longer shared with you.
collections_view_conflict: Someone else saved this view after you opened it. Your changes are still here.
collections_view_sharing_note: Sharing a view never gives access to records. Each person sees only what their role allows.
collections_view_sharing_requires_manage: Sharing with others needs permission to manage views.
collections_view_save_failed: The view couldn’t be saved. Try again.
collections_field_no_permission: Your role can’t see this field.
collections_needs_repair: This view uses filters or a grouping you can’t use here. Remove them to see the list.
collections_groups_truncated: Showing the first 50 groups. Narrow the filters to see the rest.
collections_view_manage: Manage view: history, actions and charts
collections_describe_note: Luma proposes filters from your description. Nothing changes until you choose which ones to apply.
collections_describe_placeholder: For example: open orders over €500 placed in the last 7 days
collections_describe_apply: {count, plural, one {Apply {count, number} filter} other {Apply {count, number} filters}}
collections_describe_failed: Filters couldn’t be proposed. Try again, or add them with + Filter.
collections_describe_other_list: That description fits another list. Describe what to find in this list.
collections_export_done: {count, plural, one {Exported {count, number} row.} other {Exported {count, number} rows.}}
collections_export_done_truncated: Exported the first {count, number} rows. More rows match; narrow the filters to export the rest.
collections_export_truncated: More rows match than one export can hold. Narrow the filters to export the rest.
collections_export_failed: The list couldn’t be exported. Try again.
collections_bulk_selected: {count, plural, one {{count, number} selected} other {{count, number} selected}}
collections_bulk_limit: Select at most {count, number} rows to run an action on them together.
collections_bulk_no_actions: This view has no actions. Save a view with governed actions to act on several rows at once.
collections_summary_unavailable: The summary isn’t available for these filters. Narrow them, or open the view’s settings to adjust its metrics.
collections_view_order_note: Choose the order of this list’s view tabs. Views that don’t fit the row move into the menu at its end, starting with the last. The order is yours and doesn’t change it for others.
